hero.headline: A Feast of Authentic Flavours
hero.subheading: Every dish is crafted with time-honoured recipes, premium ingredients, and a deep passion for authentic cuisine. Browse our menu categories and let us create a bespoke dining experience for your celebration.

filterNote: All menu items are available in customized combinations. Dietary preferences, portion sizes, and special requests are always accommodated.

categories.label: Indian Cuisine
categories.description: Rich, aromatic, and deeply satisfying — our Indian cuisine menu spans the breadth of the subcontinent's culinary heritage, from slow-simmered Mughlai gravies to vibrant street-food classics.

items.name: Dal Makhani
items.desc: Whole black lentils slow-cooked overnight in a rich, buttery tomato gravy with cream and a touch of fenugreek

items.name: Paneer Butter Masala
items.desc: Soft cottage cheese cubes in a velvety tomato-cashew sauce, finished with cream and aromatic spices

items.name: Dum Chicken Biryani
items.desc: Fragrant long-grain basmati layered with saffron-marinated chicken, slow-cooked on dum for maximum depth of flavour

items.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
items.desc: Tender bone-in lamb slow-braised in a Kashmiri spice blend of dried red chillies, fennel, and whole aromatics

items.name: Chole Bhature
items.desc: Boldly spiced Punjabi chickpea curry served with pillowy deep-fried bhature — a crowd favourite at every event

items.name: Palak Paneer
items.desc: Fresh cottage cheese in a smooth, vibrant spinach sauce seasoned with cumin, garlic, and a hint of cream

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.desc: Tandoor-kissed chicken in a silky, mildly spiced tomato-butter sauce — the dish that defines Indian catering

items.name: Vegetable Dum Biryani
items.desc: Seasonal vegetables and whole spices layered with saffron-infused basmati, sealed and slow-cooked on dum

items.name: Shahi Paneer
items.desc: Cottage cheese in a royal Mughlai gravy of cashews, cream, and fragrant whole spices — rich and indulgent

items.name: Lamb Keema Matar
items.desc: Minced lamb cooked with green peas, ginger, garlic, and a warming blend of whole spices

items.name: Aloo Gobi Masala
items.desc: Cauliflower and potato dry-cooked with turmeric, cumin, and fresh coriander — a classic North Indian staple

items.name: Chicken Korma
items.desc: Tender chicken braised in a fragrant, mildly spiced yoghurt and almond sauce with rose water and saffron

categories.label: Hakka Chinese
categories.description: Authentic Hakka Chinese cuisine — bold, wok-tossed, and perfectly spiced. Our Indo-Chinese classics are a beloved staple of every Indian celebration.

items.name: Hakka Noodles
items.desc: Wok-tossed egg noodles with crisp vegetables, soy sauce, and a hint of chilli — the definitive Hakka classic

items.name: Chicken Manchurian
items.desc: Crispy battered chicken tossed in a tangy, spicy Manchurian sauce with spring onions and bell peppers

items.name: Veg Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-tossed long-grain rice with fresh vegetables, eggs, soy, and sesame oil — light, fragrant, and satisfying

items.name: Chilli Paneer
items.desc: Crispy cottage cheese cubes tossed in a bold chilli-garlic-soy sauce with capsicum and spring onions

items.name: Schezwan Noodles
items.desc: Fiery wok-tossed noodles in house-made Schezwan sauce with vegetables and a smoky chilli finish

items.name: Honey Chilli Chicken
items.desc: Double-fried chicken strips glazed in a sticky honey-chilli sauce — crispy outside, juicy inside

items.name: Crispy Veg Spring Rolls
items.desc: Golden-fried rolls packed with seasoned cabbage, carrots, and glass noodles, served with sweet chilli dip

items.name: Manchow Soup
items.desc: Thick, deeply flavoured soup with vegetables, tofu, and crispy fried noodles — a warming starter favourite

items.name: Chicken Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-tossed rice with tender chicken, egg, spring onions, and a rich soy-sesame seasoning

items.name: Gobi Manchurian
items.desc: Crispy cauliflower florets in a tangy, spiced Manchurian sauce — a vegetarian showstopper

categories.label: Live Cooking Stations
categories.description: An immersive culinary theatre experience — our live stations bring the art of cooking to your guests in real time, creating moments as memorable as the food itself.

items.name: Pani Puri Station
items.desc: Live chaat station with freshly fried puris, spiced tamarind water, and a full array of toppings — always a crowd magnet

items.name: Masala Dosa Station
items.desc: Crispy golden dosas made to order, filled with spiced potato masala and served with sambar and three chutneys

items.name: Chaat Counter
items.desc: Bhel puri, sev puri, papdi chaat, and aloo tikki freshly assembled with chutneys and toppings to order

items.name: Live Wok Station
items.desc: Guests choose their protein, vegetables, and sauce — stir-fried to order in a blazing wok right before their eyes

items.name: Kulfi & Falooda Bar
items.desc: Traditional Indian ice cream served on sticks or in glasses with rose syrup, basil seeds, and vermicelli

items.name: Pasta Station
items.desc: Made-to-order pasta with choice of penne or fusilli, three sauces, and a selection of toppings and proteins

items.name: Frankie & Kathi Roll Station
items.desc: Freshly rolled kathi rolls with choice of paneer, chicken, or egg filling, wrapped in a flaky paratha

categories.label: BBQ & Tandoor
categories.description: Smoky, chargrilled perfection from our traditional clay tandoor — the centrepiece of every SWAAD catering event and a highlight guests never forget.

items.name: Chicken Tikka
items.desc: Bone-in chicken pieces marinated overnight in yoghurt, ginger-garlic, and spices, grilled in the tandoor until perfectly charred

items.name: Seekh Kebab
items.desc: Minced lamb and beef blended with fresh herbs, green chilli, and spices, shaped on skewers and grilled over live charcoal

items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.desc: Thick-cut cottage cheese marinated in spiced yoghurt, grilled with capsicum, onion, and tomato in the tandoor

items.name: Tandoori Prawns
items.desc: Jumbo tiger prawns marinated in a fiery red spice paste and grilled in the tandoor — smoky, succulent, and spectacular

items.name: Malai Chicken Tikka
items.desc: Tender chicken marinated in cream, cheese, and mild spices — a delicate, melt-in-the-mouth tandoor preparation

items.name: Veg Seekh Kebab
items.desc: Spiced paneer, potato, and vegetable mixture shaped on skewers and grilled over charcoal with a smoky finish

items.name: Tandoori Roti & Garlic Naan
items.desc: Freshly baked whole-wheat rotis and buttery garlic naans pulled straight from the clay tandoor

items.name: Achari Lamb Chops
items.desc: Frenched lamb chops marinated in pickling spices and yoghurt, grilled to a perfect blush — a premium showpiece

categories.label: Desserts
categories.description: Indulge in a curated selection of traditional Indian sweets and contemporary desserts — the perfect, memorable finale to an extraordinary dining experience.

items.name: Gulab Jamun
items.desc: Soft, pillowy milk-solid dumplings soaked in rose-scented saffron sugar syrup — warm, fragrant, and irresistible

items.name: Rasmalai
items.desc: Delicate cottage cheese patties poached in milk and served in chilled saffron-cardamom cream with pistachios

items.name: Saffron Kheer
items.desc: Slow-cooked creamy rice pudding infused with saffron, cardamom, and topped with toasted almonds and rose petals

items.name: Gajar Halwa
items.desc: Slow-cooked grated carrot pudding with pure ghee, full-fat milk, cardamom, and a garnish of cashews and raisins

items.name: Crispy Jalebi
items.desc: Freshly fried spiral pastries soaked in warm saffron sugar syrup — best enjoyed straight from the pan

items.name: Alphonso Mango Kulfi
items.desc: Traditional dense Indian ice cream made with reduced milk and fresh Alphonso mango pulp, served on a stick

items.name: Shahi Tukda
items.desc: Fried bread soaked in saffron-infused rabri, garnished with silver leaf and crushed pistachios — a Mughlai classic

items.name: Moong Dal Halwa
items.desc: Slow-roasted split moong lentil pudding cooked in ghee with sugar, cardamom, and topped with slivered almonds

categories.label: Beverages
categories.description: A curated selection of traditional Indian drinks and contemporary beverages — crafted to refresh, complement every course, and delight every guest.

items.name: Alphonso Mango Lassi
items.desc: Thick, chilled yoghurt drink blended with fresh Alphonso mango pulp, a pinch of cardamom, and a touch of honey

items.name: Rose & Basil Sharbat
items.desc: Chilled rose-infused drink with swollen basil seeds, a squeeze of lime, and a hint of kewra water

items.name: Masala Chai
items.desc: Freshly brewed spiced Indian tea with whole ginger, green cardamom, cinnamon, and full-fat milk

items.name: Mint Lime Soda
items.desc: Freshly squeezed lime with sparkling water, crushed mint, black salt, and a choice of sweet or salted

items.name: Thandai
items.desc: Traditional chilled milk drink blended with almonds, fennel, rose petals, and warming spices — a festive favourite

items.name: Aam Panna
items.desc: Tangy raw mango cooler with roasted cumin, black salt, and fresh mint — a perfect summer refresher

items.name: Jaljeera
items.desc: Cumin-spiced tamarind water with black salt, ginger, and fresh coriander — a classic digestive aperitif

items.name: Salted Lassi
items.desc: Thick churned yoghurt with roasted cumin, black salt, and fresh mint — cooling, savoury, and deeply satisfying

cta.headline: Can't Find What You're Looking For?
cta.subheading: Our menu is fully customizable. Share your vision, dietary requirements, and event details — we'll craft a bespoke menu just for you.
cta.note: Every menu is tailored to your event. Our team will work closely with you to finalize the perfect selection.
